description.raw: '''Passive:''' '''Fizz's''' basic attacks rend enemies [[File:On-hit icon.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#On_Hitting|An icon representing the keyword On-hit]] [[:Attack_effects#On_Hitting|on-hit]], dealing magic damage every 0.5 seconds over 3 seconds, refreshing on subsequent hits.
description.text: Passive: Fizz's basic attacks rend enemies on-hit, dealing magic damage every 0.5 seconds over 3 seconds, refreshing on subsequent hits.

description2.raw: '''Active:''' '''Fizz''' empowers his next [[File:Basic attack cursor icon.png|20px|link=Basic attack|An icon representing the keyword Basic attack]] [[:Basic attack|basic attack]] within 4 seconds to have an [[File:Relentless Force 2.png|20px|link=Basic attack#Uncancellable Windup|An icon representing the keyword Uncancellable windup]] [[:Basic attack#Uncancellable Windup|uncancellable windup]], gain [[File:Range icon.png|15px|link=Range]] 50 '''bonus''' range, and deal '''bonus''' magic damage.
description2.text: Active: Fizz empowers his next basic attack within 4 seconds to have an uncancellable windup, gain  50 bonus range, and deal bonus magic damage.

description3.raw: If ''Seastone Trident'' kills its target, the [[File:Cooldown icon.png|15px|link=Cooldown]] cooldown is reduced to 1 second and the [[File:Mana icon.svg|15px|link=Mana]] mana cost is refunded. Otherwise, if the target is not killed, '''Fizz's''' basic attacks deal '''bonus''' magic damage [[File:On-hit icon.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#On_Hitting|An icon representing the keyword On-hit]] [[:Attack_effects#On_Hitting|on-hit]] for the next 5 seconds.
description3.text: If Seastone Trident kills its target, the  cooldown is reduced to 1 second and the  mana cost is refunded. Otherwise, if the target is not killed, Fizz's basic attacks deal bonus magic damage on-hit for the next 5 seconds.

description4.raw: ''Seastone Trident's'' active damage can be applied against [[File:Structure icon.png|20px|link=Category:Structure|An icon representing the keyword Structure]] [[:Category:Structure|structures]] at 50% effectiveness. Active and on-hit damage deal an additional 90 '''bonus''' magic damage against [[File:Monster icon.png|20px|link=Monster|An icon representing the keyword Monster]] [[:Monster|monsters]].
description4.text: Seastone Trident's active damage can be applied against structures at 50% effectiveness. Active and on-hit damage deal an additional 90 bonus magic damage against monsters.

description5.raw: ''Seastone Trident [[File:Bladework.png|20px|link=Basic attack#Attack reset|An icon representing the keyword Basic attack reset]] [[:Basic attack#Attack reset|resets]] '''Fizz's''' basic attack timer.''
description5.text: Seastone Trident resets Fizz's basic attack timer.

notes.text:
Applies spell damage on the empowered attack, persistent damage additionally tagged as indirect damage on the damage over time effect, and proc damage on the bonus damage on-hit.
Seastone Trident's interactions with dodging, blocking, and blinding effects.
* The passive bonus damage gets negated by dodging or blocking the attack, or if Fizz is blinded.
* The active:
** If the attacked enemy is dodging or if Fizz is blinded, the empowered attack won't deal any damage, but the empowered attack won't be consumed.
** If the attacked enemy is blocking, the empowered attack won't deal any damage despite being consumed. But the attack will apply the passive bonus damage of Seastone Trident.
The empowered attack will trigger against structures.
